metadata.description: The AURORA Agent (bioprism) plugin marketplace: the FIBER decision-context compiler, 259 MCP tools, mission orchestration, operations evidence, SDK integration, and the honest-labelling engineering discipline — installable from the backend repo itself.

plugins.name: aurora-backend
plugins.description: Wires the bioprism MCP server (259 tools) into Claude Code, with a setup skill. Requires a built aurora-agent checkout.

plugins.name: aurora-context
plugins.description: FIBER compiler workflow: compile / explain / compare / validate / verify slash commands, the decision-context skill, and a faithfulness eval.

plugins.name: aurora-missions
plugins.description: Mission DAG lifecycle: authoring shape, preflight (dispatch: not_started), fail-closed gate acceptance, sync vs async execution.

plugins.name: aurora-honesty
plugins.description: The honest-labelling discipline for any codebase: honest-labelling creed, keep-a-claim-honest, prove-a-scanner-fires, windows-test-truth.

plugins.name: aurora-workspace
plugins.description: Engineering skills for working inside the aurora-agent workspace itself (add-module, check-parity, verify-crate, classify-blueprint-modules, measure-section-boilerplate).

plugins.name: aurora-integrate
plugins.description: Integration guide: bioprism-api HTTP gateway launch and envelope semantics, the zero-dependency TypeScript and Python SDKs, MCP wiring test harnesses.

plugins.name: aurora-ops
plugins.description: Operations evidence: the ops-auditor subagent and /health command over snapshots, capability gates, and the recovery matrix — postures reported verbatim.
